name: validate_change
title: validate_change
description: Runs a planned tool call through the static checker without executing it: GDScript is compiled in memory (nothing is written to disk), node paths are resolved against the open scene, and property bags are type-checked against the target class. Use it when you are unsure about a call you are about to make — a rejected call costs one round trip, while a bad executed call costs a playtest, a rollback, and a repair attempt. The pipeline already validates every call automatically, so this tool is for deliberate pre-flight checks, not routine use.

tool.description: Name of the tool whose call you want checked. Static checks exist for create_node_safe, attach_script_safe and safe_delete_node; any other name returns valid with no findings, because there is nothing to check statically.

params.description: The exact parameter object you would pass to that tool.

valid.description: False if any finding has severity 'error'. The pipeline refuses to execute a call when this is false.

code.description: From the script checker: parse_error, empty_source, no_extends, incompatible_base, unresolved_base, compiler_unavailable, unresolved_node_reference. From the property checker: unknown_type, unknown_property, invalid_property_type. Checking a safe_delete_node call forwards that tool's own blocker and warning codes verbatim, so this list is not exhaustive.

notes: Always succeeds — an unparseable script is a finding, not a tool error. Read 'valid', not 'ok'.
